meta.title: Devlog: November 1, 2026 - November 8, 2026
meta.description: analytics, media-library workflow improvements, and new screen-time tools took shape this week.

bullets.text: timed app access is in progress, letting people choose a short allowance when opening selected apps while counting only active use and returning to blocking when time runs out.
a new screen-time onboarding step is in progress, with a private on-device usage view, manual fallback, motion-aware presentation, and a recovery path when usage data cannot load.
custom recurring tasks are being expanded to support intervals across minutes, days, weeks, months, and years while preserving task timing and reminder settings.
task creation is being updated to better coordinate notification setup and introduce a first-task alert after onboarding for eligible subscribers.

summary.text: i'm working on making the app's screen-time features feel more useful without turning them into another thing to manage. the recurring-task work is also getting more flexible, because apparently calendars enjoy finding edge cases.

bullets.text: shipped analytics syncing and content insights that compare formats, creative approaches, story structure, descriptions, and hashtags using separate reach and engagement views.
shipped clearer analytics safeguards, including matched-age comparisons, median-based reporting, visible sample coverage, and labels that frame findings as signals rather than proof of causation.
shipped post previews and historical attribution support so analytics can connect published work to the relevant saved edit without exposing provider data in the workspace.
shipped bulk selection and deletion workflows across media and finished-output libraries, with confirmations, retained selections, and protections for related active work.
shipped unique visible media names across the library, including automatic repair of existing collisions without changing original media files or publishing history.
shipped more flexible assembly controls by making target length optional, allowing edits to be assembled around the available source material when no duration is set.
shipped improved draft posting copy that prioritizes readable on-media text and saved overlays, while keeping manual edits intact.

summary.text: i spent a lot of this week making analytics more honest and more useful at the same time. the goal is to help me spot patterns without pretending a small pile of posts has solved marketing forever.
